#include <cstdint>

#include "api/compute/common.h"
#include "api/compute/compute_kernel_api.h"
#include "api/compute/eltwise_binary_sfpu.h"
#include "api/compute/tile_move_copy.h"
#include "api/compute/bcast.h"
#include "api/compute/eltwise_unary/binop_with_scalar.h"
#include "api/compute/eltwise_unary/relu.h"
#include "api/compute/matmul.h"
#include "api/compute/pack.h"
#include "api/compute/reconfig_data_format.h"

// Common arguments: rows_base, rows_extra, bias, flag.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr uint32_t cb_x = 0, cb_w = 1, cb_out = 16, cb_g = 2, cb_acc = 17;
    const uint32_t rows_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t rows_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t bias = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t flag = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = rows_base + (core < rows_extra ? 1 : 0);
    compute_kernel_hw_startup(cb_x, cb_w, cb_out);
    cb_wait_front(cb_w, 4);
    cb_wait_front(cb_g, 2);
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < count; ++m) {
        cb_wait_front(cb_x, 2);
        tile_regs_acquire();
        matmul_block_init(cb_x, cb_w, 0, 2, 1, 2);
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
            matmul_block(cb_x, cb_w, k, k * 2, 0, 0, 2, 1, 2);
        }
        relu_tile_init();
        relu_tile(0);
        relu_tile(1);
        binop_with_scalar_tile_init();
        add_unary_tile(0, bias);
        add_unary_tile(1, bias);
        if (flag != 0) {
            reconfig_data_format(cb_g, cb_g);
            unary_bcast_init<BroadcastType::ROW>(cb_g);
            unary_bcast<BroadcastType::ROW>(cb_g, 0, 2);
            unary_bcast<BroadcastType::ROW>(cb_g, 1, 3);
            mul_binary_tile_init();
            mul_binary_tile(0, 2, 0);
            mul_binary_tile(1, 3, 1);
        } else {
            binop_with_scalar_tile_init();
            sub_unary_tile(0, 0x3f800000u);
            sub_unary_tile(1, 0x3f800000u);
        }
        tile_regs_commit();
        tile_regs_wait();
        cb_reserve_back(cb_out, 2);
        pack_tile<true>(0, cb_out, 0);
        pack_tile<true>(1, cb_out, 1);
        pack_reconfig_data_format(cb_acc);
        cb_reserve_back(cb_acc, 1);
        pack_tile<true>(0, cb_acc, 0);
        pack_reconfig_l1_acc(1);
        pack_tile<true>(1, cb_acc, 0);
        pack_reconfig_l1_acc(0);
        pack_reconfig_data_format(cb_out);
        tile_regs_release();
        cb_push_back(cb_out, 2);
        cb_push_back(cb_acc, 1);
        cb_pop_front(cb_x, 2);
    }
    cb_pop_front(cb_w, 4);
    cb_pop_front(cb_g, 2);
}
